_comment: SUPERSEDED (FR-144, 2026-08-28). Historical, UNPINNED baseline: it records no epoch_id/corpus_hash, so there is no evidence of which population it measured -- 164 crates linted / 16 skipped over the 180 .c files of the day, while the corpus later grew to 186, which is why its `68 -> 72` fire was attributable to nothing. Kept unchanged as the record of that measurement; the authoritative ratchet baseline is clippy-baseline-epoch4.json and clippy_eval.py REFUSES to ratchet against this file.
